title: DriftGuard: Safety-Aware Multi-Monitor Detection and Selective Adaptation for Evolving Toxicity Moderation
abstract: arXiv:2606.28725v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automated toxicity moderation systems operate in dynamic online environments where harmful behavior evolves through coded language, shifting targets, and strategic adaptation to enforcement. Existing drift detection methods often focus on global distributional change, but such signals may miss safety-relevant shifts that emerge in localized harm subspaces or high-risk model-error regions. This paper introduces DriftGuard, a safety-aware adaptive moderation framework that combines multi-monitor drift detection with selective model updating. The framework tracks global text drift, identity-harm drift, model uncertainty, toxic-risk drift, and false-negative-risk drift. When safety-relevant change is detected, the model is updated using a hard-mix adaptation set that prioritizes likely false negatives, identity-related high-risk examples, false-positive-risk examples, and uncertain boundary cases. translated_title: DriftGuard：面向演化毒性内容审核的安全感知多监控器检测与选择性适应
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.28725v2 公告类型： replace  摘要：自动化毒性内容审核系统运行于动态在线环境中，其中有害行为通过暗语、攻击目标转移以及对审核策略的适应性规避而不断演化。现有的漂移检测方法通常聚焦于全局分布变化，但此类信号可能遗漏出现在局部有害子空间或高风险模型错误区域中的安全相关变化。本文提出了 DriftGuard，一个安全感知的自适应审核框架，将多监控器漂移检测与选择性模型更新相结合。该框架跟踪全局文本漂移、身份伤害漂移、模型不确定性、毒性风险漂移以及假阴性风险漂移。当检测到安全相关变化时，模型使用一个“困难混合”（hard-mix）适应集进行更新，该集合优先纳入可能的假阴性样本、与身份相关的高风险样本、假阳性风险样本以及不确定的边界样本。在 Civil Comments 时间序列数据上的实验……
tldr: 论文提出 DriftGuard 框架，通过监控全局文本漂移、身份伤害漂移、模型不确定性和假阴性风险等多个维度的安全相关漂移信号，检测毒性内容审核中的安全隐患，并利用优先纳入高风险样本的困难混合适应集对模型进行选择性更新，以应对不断演化的有害内容。
en_tdlr: DriftGuard is a safety-aware adaptive toxicity moderation framework that combines multi-monitor drift detection (tracking global text drift, identity-harm drift, model uncertainty, toxic-risk, and false-negative-risk) with selective model updating via a hard-mix adaptation set prioritizing high-risk examples, to catch safety-relevant shifts that global distributional signals miss.
